summary: The filing reports two material definitive agreements: an equity line of credit (Stock Purchase Agreement) with Tacora Capital for up to $10M of common stock via monthly installments at VWAP, and a $4M Loan Agreement to Cumberland Coal Corp at 10% interest. Neither constitutes a change-of-control transaction, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other classic special situation. The equity line is a financing vehicle, not an acquisition or capital return event; the loan is a credit facility. No forced management change, activist campaign, or strategic review is indicated. Accordingly, this 8-K is a routine disclosure of financing arrangements.
